description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5340013540935 CATCH,CLAMPING: Line 0001 Qty 488 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0056 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
